prompt: It was a dark and stormy night. I pulled my shawl tightly around my shoulders and pressed forward. Just ahead I saw
response: a flicker of light, and as I approached, I found a cozy little tea shop. The warmth and aroma of fresh tea were inviting, and I decided to stay for a while. As I sipped my tea, I felt the storm outside intensify, but I was content to wait it out in this charming place.
